intent: Analyze system state baseline for ASUS ROG Strix G17 laptop experiencing constant shutdowns and BSODs.
detected_fault: Constant loop of turning on and shutting down with occasional BSODs, persists even when unplugged.
suggested_solution: Clean out the laptop's interior to remove dust or debris causing overheating
Reset BIOS by switching off, removing battery, and reseating drive(s) and RAM
